description:
The empty-string-vs-null contract is centralized at the Parquet conversion layer
(data_loader.py, strings_can_be_null = null_marker is not None), and
prefer_parquet=True is the default - so the DEFAULT path is consistent. But on the
prefer_parquet=False CSV-direct path the contract is NOT uniform:
  - pandas_df.py:378 and polars_df.py:283 restore '' for empty fields when
    null_marker is None (dask/modin/cudf do likewise).
  - pyspark_df.py:461 returns directly after CSV load (Spark emits null for empty
    fields by default).
  - datafusion_df.py:511 documents null_marker as "Unused".
So for a null-marker-less benchmark (e.g. ClickBench), a prefer_parquet=False run
on PySpark or DataFusion emits NULL where the SQL reference (and the other
adapters) emit "" - the exact Q6/Q17/Q18 divergence class the polars adapter's own
comment warns about. It is non-default, hence latent, but it is a real
cross-surface fidelity gap and will silently mis-compare if that path is exercised.

Prefer a SINGLE shared post-coercion (so future adapters inherit it) over
per-adapter patches.

anti_patterns.dont: patch only PySpark and DataFusion in isolation
anti_patterns.why: centralize so future adapters inherit the contract.

preserves.behavior: JoinOrder and other null_marker='' benchmarks still map empty -> NULL; the fix is null_marker-driven, not a blanket empty->'' for all.
The production DataFrame run path is reused, not forked; the change is additive.
prefer_parquet=True (default) load behavior is byte-unchanged for every adapter.

verifications.description: CSV-direct empty-string parity on the two lagging adapters
verifications.expected: 0 empty-string-vs-null divergences; JoinOrder still nulls empties

work_units.notes:
Add one shared post-load step (in benchmark_mixin/shared_loading) that, when
null_marker is None, restores '' for empty string-typed fields - applied
uniformly across adapters, including PySpark (emptyValue/post-read restore) and
DataFusion. Resolve null_marker via resolve_csv_dialect (the benchmark
instance's marker), not a file-extension heuristic. Keep prefer_parquet=True
behavior byte-unchanged.
work_units.summary: Add a shared null_marker-aware empty-string post-coercion on the CSV-direct path

work_units.notes:
Extend coverage to run a null-marker-less benchmark (ClickBench) cross-surface
on PySpark and DataFusion with prefer_parquet=False and assert zero
empty-string-vs-null divergences. Add a focused regression naming the Q6/Q17/
Q18 pattern. Confirm JoinOrder (null_marker="") still nulls empties (must not
regress the opposite direction).
work_units.summary: Gate the fix: ClickBench cross-surface on PySpark/DataFusion with prefer_parquet=False
